{{Top}}
'''Actuators''' were [[Droid/Legends|droid]] components. Replacement actuators were included in the [[droid customization kit]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> Specific actuators included the metatarsal actuator.<ref name="AI">{{WEGCite|story=Abregado-Rae Intrigue|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>

They were also parts for a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
